before.lead: A wedding package can change when the property is available, which spaces are included and who handles setup. I help Augusta County businesses explain those practical differences before a couple asks for a quote.

before.lead: A building's opening hours may extend beyond its last tour departure. I help Bland County businesses explain the experience window, visit format and group arrangements before someone makes the trip.

after.lead: A campsite, a furnished cottage and a rental RV can share a property while asking guests to bring very different things. I help Page County businesses explain the stay before sending visitors to the booking service.
after.decisionTitle: Compare what the guest brings with what the accommodation provides.
after.decision: Luray RV Resort on Shenandoah River presents RV sites, cottages, Airstream rentals, glamping tents and tent camping. Its FAQ also asks guests to confirm pet rules for the chosen accommodation. That range makes a useful website-planning problem: a broad amenity list must not make a site for a customer's own RV look like a supplied rental unit. I can clarify existing accommodation descriptions or build a fuller comparison that preserves each stay type through the booking handoff.

scopes.title: Clarify the ways-to-stay section
scopes.request: State what is supplied and what the guest brings beside each option, then link to the appropriate existing booking category.
scopes.supplies: Current stay types, verified equipment and amenity lists, approved pet information and existing booking destinations.
scopes.check: A visitor choosing an RV site understands that the site does not itself include a rental RV.

scopes.title: Build a stay-selection introduction
scopes.request: Separate property-wide features from amenities specific to a site or unit. Help the visitor raise unresolved needs before booking.
scopes.supplies: Unit descriptions, accurate photographs, current amenities and the person responsible for synchronizing public descriptions with booking listings.
scopes.check: A guest bringing a pet can identify which accommodation's rules need checking without treating a general pet-friendly label as universal approval.

planningTable.title: An accommodation-content brief
planningTable.intro: Complete one version for each stay type. The owner confirms amenities and policies; the website does not infer them from a category name.

after.scopeTrigger: Live availability, reservation changes, campsite-map systems and payment handling need separate scope. Existing booking links can remain the transaction route.

sources.label: Luray RV Resort: facilities by accommodation
sources.observation: Distinguishes RV sites from Airstream rentals with kitchenette, full bathroom and air conditioning; glamping tents include a kitchenette and private bathroom, while primitive riverfront tent sites are walk-in.
